phases.name: Auth Foundation
phases.goal: Set up authentication primitives and middleware
exitCriteria: Tests pass for all three tasks

tasks.title: Define User model and auth schema
tasks.description: Create src/db/schema/user.ts with User model (id, email, passwordHash, createdAt). Add a migration file in src/db/migrations/. Target files: src/db/schema/user.ts, src/db/migrations/001_create_users.sql.

tasks.title: Create login API route
tasks.description: Add POST /api/auth/login in src/app/api/auth/login/route.ts. Accept email and password, verify against User model, return a signed JWT. Target files: src/app/api/auth/login/route.ts.
notes: Use existing JWT_SECRET from env config
Add tests for valid credentials and invalid credentials

tasks.title: Create auth middleware
tasks.description: Implement middleware in src/middleware/auth.ts that extracts the JWT from the Authorization header, verifies it, and attaches the user to the request context. Target files: src/middleware/auth.ts.
notes: Return 401 for missing or invalid tokens
Add tests for happy path and expired token

tasks.title: Wire auth middleware into protected routes
tasks.description: Apply auth middleware to the existing /api/todos and /api/folders route groups in src/app/api/todos/route.ts and src/app/api/folders/route.ts. Target files: src/app/api/todos/route.ts, src/app/api/folders/route.ts.
